title: GAX-P03 - First trainable non-generative GAX v0
outcome: Establish the first genuine trainable GAX typed-decision model with deterministic training, integrity-bound checkpoints, deterministic inference, GAXBench integration, and a research-safe model card before ECAL experiments begin.
rationale: P00-P02 froze the research, benchmark, and comparison contracts. P03 must now prove the complete model lifecycle without conflating lifecycle qualification with clinical backbone selection or ECAL novelty. A dependency-light bilinear state/action reference model is sufficient for this gate and can be qualified on free CPU CI.
scope_in: Pure-Python deterministic GAX bilinear state/action reference model
Integrity-bound JSON checkpoint schema and fail-closed loader
GAX adapter integration with the existing GAXBench runner
P03 architecture contract and model-card draft
scope_out: No clinical performance or safety claim
acceptance: GAX v0 accepts caller-provided finite actions and emits normalized probabilities over exactly those action IDs without free-form generation
Action IDs are preserved as schema identifiers but excluded from semantic action featurization
Training accepts train split items only and optional validation split items, rejects missing labels and duplicate IDs, and never consumes test labels
Fixed-seed training reduces NLL on the abstract learnable smoke fixture and learns its deterministic alpha/beta mapping
Repeated fixed-seed training is deterministic within the declared protocol
Checkpoint payload binds architecture, feature revision, config, weights, seed, training manifest hash, epoch count, and a canonical integrity digest
Checkpoint loading fails closed on integrity mismatch, unsupported revision, malformed dimensions, or non-finite parameters
Checkpoint round trip preserves model revision and predictions
Loaded GAX v0 runs through the existing GAXBench run_baseline path with no alternate metric implementation
Train/evaluate CLI runs end to end on repository synthetic fixtures
Synthetic fixtures are registered as CC0, contain no clinical text or PHI, and are forbidden for clinical or paper performance claims
Model card explicitly prohibits diagnosis, treatment, prescribing, triage, emergency guidance, patient advice, and clinical-performance claims
Exact-head CI passes Ruff, mypy strict, pytest, and compileall on Python 3.11/3.12 across Linux and Windows
Implementation merge and post-main CI succeed before a separate canonical closeout marks SG-000006 PROVEN

risk.recovery: Revert P03 files and return to canonical P02 at 8424a84b94fc980523497d79a35a2421a8de6b29. P03 introduces no external model weight, clinical dataset, or public performance claim.

minimality.rationale: A small pure-Python bilinear model is the minimum genuine trainable typed model that proves the lifecycle contract without preselecting the final clinical backbone or requiring paid compute.

requirements: Synthetic smoke metrics are infrastructure evidence only.
Do not interpret top-1 probability as permission to act.
Do not introduce real patient data or clinical-use claims.
Do not promote the reference architecture as the final paper model without later evidence.

unresolved_decisions: Final GAX clinical backbone remains a later controlled experiment.
ECAL objective components remain P04 hypotheses.
Learned sufficiency and selective policy remain P05 hypotheses.
